config.moduleName: Settle - Seat Collision for SMP Cloth

plugin.name: Main (recommended)
plugin.description:
Seat collision for SMP cloth (cloth rests on chairs, benches and stools instead of passing through them) PLUS the seated hug: while seated, the lower cloth of short skirts and robes is tied to the legs so it lies on the lap. Long skirts automatically keep normal physics + seat collision. Works for the player and NPCs.
Requires Faster HDT-SMP 4.1.1 installed; Settle must overwrite its hdtsmp64.dll (place Settle below / after FSMP).

plugin.name: Collision Only
plugin.description:
Only the seat collision: cloth rests on seats instead of passing through them, but is otherwise simulated normally (no seated hug, no seat swap). Both can be turned on later in SKSE\Plugins\Settle.ini (bAutoHug = 1, bSeatSwap = 1).
Requires Faster HDT-SMP 4.1.1 installed; Settle must overwrite its hdtsmp64.dll (place Settle below / after FSMP).
